'''Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck''' is the 27th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher on 25 October 2000. It is twenty exclusive black-border premiums (10 per side), six [[Jabba's Palace Limited]] boosters, and a 300-card storage box. One of six covers is concealed at purchase: Bib Fortuna, Chewbacca, Gamorrean Guard, Han Solo (frozen in carbonite), Lando, or Salacious Crumb. MSRP $19.95. CardGuide numbering: 27th product.

The six Jabba's Palace boosters are reprints and are not listed.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

[[Lando With Vibro-Ax]] was printed without a permanent weapon icon. The [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III]] foil corrected it.<ref name="encyc" />
